To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CellOS is a fully automated framework that allows TOs to optimize their networks without requiring any vendor support or manual operations.

CellOS: (a) is a fully automated optimization framework that allows TOs to express their control objectives as a high-level network policy; (b) is platform-independent; (c) is capable of optimizing heterogeneous control objectives simultaneously; (d) outperforms existing approaches in terms of key performance metrics.

CellOS is: 1) the first zero-touch framework for cellular networks, 2) the first to leverage softwarization and optimization principles to bridge SDN and cross-layer optimization, and 3) the first to enable the simultaneous optimization of multiple heterogeneous control objectives on multiple network slices.
